topic: 流程说明与学术阶段复测
grammarFocus: 被动语态；顺序连接词；定语从句与分词短语的辨认。
title: A Campus Tour: The Library Renovation
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力与阅读练习材料，适合B1–B2水平学习者。请先听录音（或阅读听力原文），然后完成10道题目。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。所有答案必须来自材料原文。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。完成题目后，可参考词汇表和语法讲解。本材料为原创模拟内容，并非官方雅思试题。
transcript:
Guide: Good morning, everyone. Welcome to the campus tour. My name is Alex, and I'm a student volunteer. Today, we'll visit three main buildings: the library, the science center, and the student union. The library is being renovated at the moment, so we can't go inside. But you can see the new glass front from here. The renovation started in June and will be finished by December. The old reading room, which was on the second floor, has been moved to the basement. It's much bigger now.
Student 1: Excuse me, is the library open during the renovation?
Guide: Yes, it is. The basement reading room is open from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day. The main entrance is closed, so you need to use the side door on Green Street. Oh, and the café on the first floor is closed until October.
Student 2: What about the science center? Is that new?
Guide: No, it's not new. It was built in 1995, but it was updated last year. The labs, which are on the third floor, have new equipment. The science center is connected to the library by a covered walkway. You can walk between them without going outside.
Student 1: Sorry, did you say the walkway is covered?
Guide: Yes, that's right. It's covered, so you can use it even when it rains. Now, let's move on to the student union. The student union is the oldest building on campus. It was built in 1920. It has a large hall, which is used for concerts and meetings. The hall can hold 500 people. The student union also has a small shop and a post office.
Student 2: Is there a place to eat in the student union?
Guide: Yes, there's a café on the ground floor. It serves hot and cold food. It's open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. The student union is being repainted next month, so the café will be closed for two days. We'll let you know the exact dates later.
Student 1: Thank you. That's very helpful.
Guide: You're welcome. Are there any more questions? No? OK, let's continue the tour. Please follow me to the science center.

questions.prompt: What is happening to the library at the moment?
questions.explanation: 导游明确说“The library is being renovated at the moment”，因此图书馆正在翻新。其他选项与原文不符。
questions.evidence: The library is being renovated at the moment, so we can't go inside.

questions.prompt: The old reading room has been moved to the ________.
questions.explanation: 原文提到“The old reading room... has been moved to the basement.”，因此填basement。
questions.evidence: The old reading room, which was on the second floor, has been moved to the basement.

questions.prompt: Which entrance should students use to enter the library during the renovation?
options: The side door on Green Street.
answers: The side door on Green Street.
questions.explanation: 导游说“The main entrance is closed, so you need to use the side door on Green Street.”，因此应使用Green Street的侧门。
questions.evidence: The main entrance is closed, so you need to use the side door on Green Street.

questions.evidence: It was built in 1995, but it was updated last year.

questions.explanation: 导游确认“It's covered, so you can use it even when it rains.”，因此走道是有顶棚的。
questions.evidence: It's covered, so you can use it even when it rains.

questions.explanation: 原文明确说“The student union is the oldest building on campus.”，因此该陈述为真。
questions.evidence: The student union is the oldest building on campus.

questions.prompt: The large hall in the student union can hold ________ people.
questions.explanation: 原文提到“The hall can hold 500 people.”，因此填500。

questions.evidence: It's open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

options: Because the student union is being repainted.
answers: Because the student union is being repainted.
questions.explanation: 原文说“The student union is being repainted next month, so the café will be closed for two days.”，因此原因是学生会楼正在被重新粉刷。
questions.evidence: The student union is being repainted next month, so the café will be closed for two days.

grammar.title: 被动语态；顺序连接词；定语从句与分词短语的辨认
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，结构为be + 过去分词。顺序连接词如first, then, next, finally用于组织步骤。定语从句用who, which, that等引导，修饰名词；分词短语（如built in 1995）可替代定语从句，使句子更简洁。
grammar.example: The library is being renovated at the moment.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The new lab ________ last year.
questions.explanation: 实验室是“被建造”，且时间是last year，因此用一般过去时的被动语态was built。
questions.evidence: It was built in 1995, but it was updated last year.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses a sequencing word correctly?
options: First, we visited the library. Then, we went to the science center.
First, we visited the library. But, we went to the science center.
First, we visited the library. However, we went to the science center.
First, we visited the library. Because, we went to the science center.
answers: First, we visited the library. Then, we went to the science center.
questions.explanation: Then表示顺序，符合逻辑。But, However, Because不表示顺序。
questions.evidence: Now, let's move on to the student union.

questions.prompt: Identify the relative clause in: 'The old reading room, which was on the second floor, has been moved to the basement.'
options: which was on the second floor
has been moved to the basement
answers: which was on the second floor
questions.explanation: 定语从句由which引导，修饰the old reading room，说明其位置。
questions.evidence: The old reading room, which was on the second floor, has been moved to the basement.

questions.prompt: Which phrase is a participle phrase?
questions.explanation: built in 1995是过去分词短语，相当于定语从句which was built in 1995。
questions.evidence: It was built in 1995, but it was updated last year.
